title: Devolutions Remote Desktop Management & IT Operations Software Licenses and Premium Support
agency: NATIONAL TRANSPORTATION SAFETY BOARD.NATIONAL TRANSPORTATION SAFETY BOARD.NTSB ACQ  LEASE MGMT DIVISION
description_text: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) requires the renewal of Devolutions Remote Desktop Management & IT Operations Software Licenses, including Premium Support. This requirement is for a 12-month base period with two (2) option years. Required Items: DEVO-RCM – Remote Desktop Management & IT Operations, 12-month subscription renewal | Quantity: 65 SUP-PRE – Premium Support | Quantity: 1 Period of Performance: Base Year: May 1, 2026 – April 30, 2027 Option Year 1: May 1, 2027 – April 30, 2028 Option Year 2: May 1, 2028 – April 30, 2029 Please see the attached JOFOC, Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, and Attachment 1 for additional information.
